create_empty_data: create an empty data object with marginals, forests, traces, and ranks for a given number of MCMC chains
create_figures: create Bokeh figures for marginal, forest, trace, and rank plots given a random variable name and chain count
create_glyphs: create Line, Circle, and Quad glyphs with hover variants for each chain across all figure types
create_view: create a tabbed Bokeh view with marginal, HDI, trace, and rank plot panels plus a help tab
create_widgets: create a Select widget for random variable queries and Slider widgets for bandwidth factor and HDI controls
